metadata.description: The enforcement layer for agent memory: a typed decision ledger kept outside compaction, audited after every compaction, and enforced at tool-call time.

plugins.name: epistemic-monitor
plugins.description: Decision ledger, compaction audit and re-pinning, conformance gate, Stop and subagent turn checks, /ledger command, optional MCP ledger tools.

plugins.name: epistemic-panel
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat showing the ledger: retention at the last compaction, review items, and the last interventions (/epistemic).
